content: Truth is ever to be found in simplicity, and not in the multiplicity and confusion of things.
author: Isaac Newton
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. We are conditioned to believe that more is always better—more possessions, more accomplishments, more stimulation. Yet our accumulation usually brings more anxiety, maintenance, and mental clutter.

Isaac Newton understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Wealth is not having endless things; it is wanting very little. When you realize that your deepest needs for peace, connection, and purpose cannot be bought, you become truly unshakeable.
reflectionPrompt: What would change in your daily outlook if you truly lived by this perspective?
